Apocalypse Shadow

Apocalyptic Shadow is a series of challenging game modes. In Apocalyptic Shadow, you need to face the projection of the Finality and defeat the bosses and formidable foes you once faced. Each period of Apocalyptic Shadow will update projections of 2 bosses, divided into 4 challenge difficulties. Completing the challenge by defeating 2 bosses at the current difficulty level will allow you to claim …

Ruinous Embers

Apocalyptic Shadow has its unique rules, and there will be different stage effects during battles. Each period of Apocalyptic Shadow has its unique effects that only take effect within the current period.

Boss Traits

In Apocalyptic Shadow, the projections of bosses and formidable foes differ from regular bosses, and you can read their traits at the beginning of the battle. As the difficulty increases, new traits will be added to the bosses.

Finality's Axiom

After each period of Apocalyptic Shadow updates, several Finality's Axiom buff effects will be added to each boss's challenge. Before challenging the boss, you can choose one of these buff effects for each team.

Points

The stage has an action value timer, and after each action by both sides, the corresponding action value will be deducted. The scoring rules at the end of the stage are influenced by two factors: The remaining boss's HP and the remaining action value after successfully defeating the boss. Quick Unlock

The highest 3-star clearance difficulty of Apocalyptic Shadow will be recorded. After each subsequent period starts, the corresponding difficulty and all its prerequisite difficulties will be quickly unlocked based on the record.
